newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume edges higher, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume edges higher, prices mixed.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange edged up to 839 kilos on Wednesday from Tuesday's 740 kilos as physical demand from the free-market increased, dealers said.

Gold closed easier in dollar terms at $349.00 an ounce from $350.00 on Tuesday, following trends in European markets, but higher in lira terms at 1,466,400 lira per gram from 1,466,200 as the lira eased against the dollar.
The Turkish currency closed at 130,750 lira per dollar from 130,440 lira on Tuesday.
"Gold's lower levels in real terms encouraged buying from the free-market traders," one dealer said.
Of the day's volume, 579 kilos was traded in the morning session and the rest in the afternoon and 76.2 percent of the total was in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
